title: Estimate single-cell fate across velocity, pseudotime, and real-time kernels
description: Direct Codex to construct separately reviewable RegVelo or scVelo velocity, pseudotime, or moscot real-time transition kernels; estimate CellRank GPCCA fate probabilities toward evidence-backed terminal states; retain lineage-driver statistics; test withheld direction and kernel sensitivity; and preserve every source cell and declared expression layer.
intents: 单细胞命运概率 RegVelo CellRank 最优传输
questions: Which terminal fates are probabilistically supported for each cell, and how sensitive are those conclusions to velocity, expression connectivity, pseudotime, or experimental-time transport assumptions?
preconditions: The H5AD has immutable declared expression values, unique cells and features, at least two evidence-backed terminal states, a mode-appropriate direction source, and new output paths. Velocity mode additionally requires aligned state and velocity matrices plus withheld time or pseudotime; real-time transport requires replicated sampling and at least three ordered times.
assumptions: Fate probabilities are conditional on the selected kernel, neighborhood, state representation, and terminal-state definition; they do not prove clonal ancestry. Velocity, connectivity blending, pseudotime, and real-time optimal transport remain separate sensitivity models.

quality_gates.description: Block guessed expression, velocity, state, representation, sample, time, pseudotime, terminal-state, feature, or source-object semantics; continuous expression is never rounded or relabelled as counts.
Every kernel transition row and every fate-probability row must be finite, nonnegative, cell-aligned, and sum to one within tolerance.
Terminal states require predeclared biological evidence and adequate cells; clamped terminal-state consistency is checked but is not misrepresented as independent validation.
Expected transition direction must agree with a mode-appropriate withheld time or pseudotime field; a directed graph alone is insufficient.
Velocity, velocity-plus-connectivity, pseudotime, and moscot optimal-transport kernels remain separately parameterized and reported; disagreement is sensitivity evidence.
Reload H5AD, transition matrix, fate table, driver table, source expression, identities, parameters, versions, and quality status.

version_differences.description: Velocity, Connectivity, Pseudotime, RealTime, kernel composition, GPCCA terminal-state assignment, fate probabilities, and lineage-driver fields are release-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Detect the release, validate transition and fate stochasticity, record every component weight, and reload all fields before widening support.

version_differences.description: TemporalProblem preparation, OTT solver arguments, transport outputs, and RealTimeKernel conversion are release-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Record time policy, representation, epsilon, convergence and coupling pairs and verify direction.

limitations: Validated execution covers CellRank 2.3.2 VelocityKernel with RegVelo state and velocity layers, velocity-plus-connectivity sensitivity, PseudotimeKernel, and moscot 0.5.1 TemporalProblem through RealTimeKernel. Public zebrafish neural-crest acceptance is conditional on one official dataset, one RegVelo-derived velocity field, four annotation-defined terminal states, and withheld stage direction; terminal-state consistency is partly imposed by GPCCA clamping and is not independent biological validation. Fate probabilities depend on kernel, neighborhood, representation, time sampling, and terminal definitions and do not establish clonal ancestry, causal regulation, or condition-level inference. Environment and compute-resource management remain outside plugin scope.

concept_sources: Project-owned fate workflow separating velocity, connectivity-weight, pseudotime, and experimental-time optimal-transport kernels.

template_sections.purpose: Establish expression, direction, kernel, representation, sampling, and terminal-state evidence.
required_logic: Inspect immutable expression and its declared semantics, any state and velocity matrices, neighborhood representation, samples, ordered time, pseudotime provenance, terminal evidence, feature namespace, cell accounting, and source digest.
Freeze kernel mode, connectivity weight, neighborhood, optimal-transport regularization, terminal cells, and quality thresholds before execution.

template_sections.purpose: Execute separate transition kernels and GPCCA fate estimation.
required_logic: Build a velocity kernel from explicitly named RegVelo or scVelo state and velocity matrices, optionally combine it with a separately weighted connectivity kernel, build a pseudotime kernel, or solve adjacent moscot temporal couplings and convert them to a RealTimeKernel.
Require row-stochastic transitions, assign declared terminal cells, compute fate probabilities without PETSc dependence, and retain lineage-driver statistics.

template_sections.purpose: Check withheld direction, terminal consistency, sensitivity, source preservation, and serialization.
required_logic: Test expected withheld experimental-time or pseudotime transition deltas and report clamped terminal-state consistency without treating it as independent validation.

Compare justified kernel or connectivity-weight variants without averaging them, then reload H5AD and evidence tables and reconcile every cell, expression value, transition, fate, driver, parameter, and version.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Use velocity only with an admitted velocity field and withheld direction evidence, pseudotime for a validated continuous ordering, and moscot for observed replicated time-point transport; run justified alternatives as sensitivity models.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Never average kernel outputs or conceal disagreement.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Freeze a pure velocity primary analysis and one biologically justified nonzero connectivity sensitivity weight before viewing fate outcomes.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Report fate and direction changes between weights; do not select a weight because it produces desired biology.

preflight_checks: Inspect actual object, expression location and semantics, velocity and state layers, representation, samples, time, pseudotime, terminal-state cells, neighbors, source digest, and output paths.
Detect exact CellRank, moscot, Scanpy, AnnData, NumPy, pandas, SciPy, JAX, OTT-JAX, and Python versions in an existing runtime.
On macOS, execute the template from a real script guarded by a main entry because CellRank kernel coordination uses multiprocessing spawn.
postflight_checks: Recompute transition and fate row sums, withheld direction, terminal-state consistency, and any declared kernel sensitivity.
Reload all objects and tables and preserve method-specific outputs and source expression exactly.
forbidden_actions: Do not manage Python, R, Conda, containers, CPU, GPU, Slurm, remote, or local-model infrastructure.
Do not round continuous expression, guess state or velocity semantics, guess terminal states, tune kernels to desired fates, average incompatible kernels, or claim fate probabilities prove ancestry.
Do not treat clamped terminal-cell fate of one as independent validation.
Do not overwrite source expression or report generated or unreloaded outputs as evidence.
